product_metadata.title: Focus Line Touchless Foaming Soap Dispenser with LCD Screen ABS Infrared Motion Sensor Waterproof 500ML Automatic Soap Dispenser Kitchen Bathroom Gold
features: 【LCD Screen & 2 Level Volume Adjustable Foam】 Automatic foaming soap dispenser has two modes of foam dispensing，Variable dispense control foam soap volume by adjusting the switch to control the soap volume from 1ml & 1.5ml. With the help of LCD screen, it easy to check the mode and the battery state.

【Touchless and Sensitive】 This automatic foam soap dispenser uses intelligent sensor technology, infrared sensors, free you from touching the soap dispenser yourself. Just put your hands beneath the nozzle within 8 cm / 3.14 inch, less than 0.26s you will get the soap

【Suitable for Various Soap 】 The capacity of the soap dispenser is 500ml, is larger than others, is a good choice for a family or public use. Recommendation: please dilute the ordinary liquid soap at 1: 3 with water (soap: water)then shake the bottles to mix them.

【Wide Range of Applications】 Made of ABS material and can be used The touchless soap dispenser can be used in the home, kindergartens, schools, restaurants, etc. You can put it on the countertop or the foaming soap dispenser can be fixed on the wall.

【After Sales & Tips】 It was powered by 4*AA batteries (not included). We will provide a perfect after-sales service, If you encounter any problems, please contact us and we will provide you with the best service.
description: Focus Line Automatic foam soap dispenser
This Automatic foam soap dispenser uses the latest design free-standing adjustable button.

The simple and sensitive LCD screen clearly shows the soap mode and the remaining battery power. It only takes 3 seconds to quickly turn on / off the power. 2 Adjustable Soap Liquid Levels, Single press can switch between high and low soap modes. Variable dispense control soap volume by adjusting the switch to control the foam volume from 1 to 1.5ml.
No dripping or trailing, no waste foam soap. Compatible with most kinds of liquid & foam.Perfect for the bathroom, kitchen, office, school, hospital, hotel, and restaurant.
Thick ABS material shell, lighter and safer, its color can fits in most usage situations.
Small and delicate nozzle, make rich foam every time you use. Hidden design, keep clean and dry all the time.
1 x automatic soap dispenser 1 x instruction manual 2 x screws and nuts

*Don’t immerse the whole machine into water. *Don’t pour liquid or gel soap into the bottle directly without dilution, otherwise it won’t foam. *Don’t tilt, or flip the machine with soap in it. *Do rinse the catheter and the bottle before a long-term non-use (15 Days or longer), to avoid the drying soap blocks the catheter. *Do make sure you have fixed the base properly before you start to use. *Do make sure there are no sundries or solid matter in soap.

Tips 1：The product is equipped with two screws and nuts. The bracket can be wall mounted by drilling with electric drill tools. Save space for your family. Tips 2：When used in a strong light environment may cause Infrared sensors to malfunction.
